app.controls.addEventListener('change', function() { 
 document.querySelectorAll('.v3d-annotation').forEach(annotation => {
 annotation.style.transition = 'opacity 0.2s ease';
 annotation.style.opacity = '0.2'; // Se vuelve casi transparente
 });

 clearTimeout(window.annotationTimeout);
 window.annotationTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
 document.querySelectorAll('.v3d-annotation').forEach(annotation => {
 annotation.style.opacity = '1'; // Reaparece
 });
 }, 100);
});
